end_game_title: Ask everyone to end the game?
end_game_description: All active players must agree. If accepted, the game ends without a winner and no game result is recorded.

complete_composition_points: Complete a valid composition to resolve its point value
ended_reported_problem: Ended after a reported game problem
ended_by_agreement_description: Every active player agreed to end without a winner
rules_description: A quick guide to turns, compositions, jokers, scoring, and winning.
onboarding_practice_description: Nothing here affects your real games.
onboarding_welcome_description: Practice one turn: draw, make a run, and discard.
onboarding_orientation_description: Draw from the deck, keep your cards in your hand, and build runs in the composition area. Finish your turn by placing a card on the discard pile.
onboarding_draw_title: Pick up from the draw pile
onboarding_draw_hint: Drag the deck card into your hand.
onboarding_compose_hint: Drag 5♠, 6♠, and 7♠ to the marked table area.
onboarding_discard_hint: Drag the Queen to the discard pile.
onboarding_complete_description: That’s the core turn: draw, compose, discard.
onboarding_completion_error: Could not save your progress. Please try again.
goal_title: Empty your hand by discarding your last card
goal_rule_1: You start each round with 12 random cards.
goal_rule_2: Win the round by playing down cards, then discarding the final card from your hand.
goal_rule_3: Keep one card for the final discard; you cannot go out by placing every card on the table.
goal_rule_4: Cards left in other players’ hands become points against them.
turn_rule_1: Draw from the deck, or take the top discard only if you can use it immediately.
turn_rule_2: Playing compositions is optional after you have drawn.
turn_rule_3: A turn ends when you discard one card.
opening_title: Your first table play must reach 40+ points
opening_example: Example opening: Kings set 30 + spade run 15 = 45
opening_rule_1: Before opening, you cannot play random additions by themselves.
opening_rule_2: Your opening turn must include at least one new composition from your hand.
opening_rule_3: Jokers in hand can help reach 40 by taking the value they represent.
jokers_title: Replace the exact card to reclaim a joker
reclaim_description: The 4 replaces the joker, then the joker returns to your hand for this turn.
joker_rule_1: A joker can stand for any card in a set or run.
joker_rule_2: To take it back, place the exact card it currently represents.
joker_rule_3: In sets, the joker must be narrowed to one missing suit before it can be reclaimed.
complete_ace_set: Complete Ace set: all four suits
complete_rule_1: A complete composition is moved to the discard pile before the final discard.
complete_rule_2: A same-suit run is complete only when it covers Ace low through King plus the second Ace high.
complete_rule_3: Completed cards leave the table, then the current player discards normally.
opening_points_description: Count the value of cards you place in compositions. Aces and jokers use the value they represent in that composition.
end_round_points_description: Only cards left in hand count. Jokers are 20. Aces are usually 10, except a final lone Ace can count as 1.
score_rule_2: Players over 100 are adjusted unless everyone else is also over 100.
score_rule_3: You win the game by forcing all other players over 100.
special_wins_title: Rare hands can end it immediately
same_suit_description: Collect all 12 cards of one suit for an immediate win.
six_pairs_description: Form 6 identical pairs for a special win condition.
quick_game_description: One casual round. Results are tracked separately from ranked play.
full_game_description: Ranked rounds continue until one player makes everybody else fly.
stats_after_first_game: Statistics will appear here after this player completes their first ranked game.
